outcome.requested_time: bank follow-up - customer said 'not ready to commit to a payment date yet' and asked about payment plan

transcript.text: Hello, I'm calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking to Rakesh Sharma?
Before we get into that, can you please tell me my total outstanding balance?
I’m sorry, but I can only discuss account details after you confirm you are Rakesh Sharma. Are you Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh Sharma. Like I said, I want to know the exact total outstanding balance on my account before we go any further. Can you provide that?

Great, thanks. I wanted to remind you that your credit card payment was due on 15th October. Your minimum amount due is 4,820 rupees. That includes interest, and a late payment fee of 750 rupees. Your total outstanding bill is 18,420 rupees.
Thanks for telling me. Can you confirm, is the total outstanding balance 18,420 rupees right now? Or does that include any pending charges or payments I made recently?
The total outstanding balance right now is 18,420 rupees. This amount includes all posted interest and late fees up to today. If you have made a recent payment, please let me know.
Okay, I haven't made any payments recently. So, 18,420 rupees is the full amount I owe as of now. Thanks for confirming that.
Thank you for confirming. By when will you be able to make the payment?
I’m not ready to commit to a payment date yet. I just needed to know the exact balance for now. Can you also tell me if there are any options for a payment plan?

Okay, noted. We'll follow up with you. I'm only here for your pending payment. For other queries, please visit a branch or call the helpline.

Thank you for your time. Have a good day.
